summary: Iteration 9: Comprehensive gameplay mechanics testing completed. All 18 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing confirmed Quick Play (6 rounds vs bot) and Club Challenge (6 rounds solo) both complete successfully. Key bug fixes verified: (1) correct_option is now returned in answer response and displayed when user answers wrong, (2) Club Challenge rounds advance correctly through all 6 rounds, (3) Game finishes with winner and score display working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 tested all core gameplay mechanics. All backend APIs pass (18/18). Quick Play vs bot works: select category → answer 3 questions → bot countdown (45s) → bot plays → round advances → repeat 6 rounds → game finishes. Club Challenge solo mode works: auto-selects Club category → answer 3 questions → round advances automatically → repeat 6 rounds → finishes with winner. correct_option bug fix verified - shows correct answer text when user gets it wrong. Profile page has minor issue where Game History shows 'No completed games' even though API returns games - frontend data fetching issue. Use testuser@quizball.com / Test12345 for testing.
